title: SMPTE RP 180 printing-density spectral responsivities
description: SMPTE RP 180-1999 printing density channel responsivities (red/green/blue), peak-normalized as published. Comparison metric only: the ECN-2 route targets Academy Printing Density (ST 2065-2, APD_ST2065-2.json); the ADX16 build prints an APD-versus-RP 180 delta line from this table. RP 180 was archived by SMPTE in December 2006.
provenance: Extracted 2026-07-16 from the inline table of an unpublished printing-density engine (its sole runtime copy until then); originally transcribed from SMPTE RP 180 in an earlier session. Verified against the full standard fetched from pub.smpte.org: all 37 wavelengths match the published table exactly in all three channels (see knowledge/densitometry-standards-and-density-metrics.md, 'Verification of the repository's copy'). The standard's 370 nm and 740 nm rows are omitted here; both are zero in every channel.
notes: Includes the sub-400 nm blue tail (380/390 nm). Blue responsivity carries ~3.5% of its integral below 400 nm — relevant to systematics register #1 (380-400 nm grid truncation, Vision3/RP 180 only). Omitting the zero 370 nm row makes a 1 nm linear resampling read 0.0026 instead of 0 at 370 nm, ~0.06% of the blue integral; the 740 nm omission has no effect since 730 nm is already zero.
